chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Two ways to play the brick. Push starts at Root and presses action buttons. Pull starts at an Output and asks for a number.

chapters.title: Push
chapters.text: Root to Composite to Selector to leaf. Side effects happen. Scores only open when the selector asks.

chapters.title: Pull
chapters.text: Output asks a data box. That box may open Variables or Qualifiers. Nothing runs until something Calculate-s it.

chapters.title: Backpack
chapters.text: The backpack keeps variables between frames. Keys include Graph Id. When a graph dies, remove only its keys.
